answer: Each validator’s EigenTrust score decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence persists only through sustained honest service; old endorsements fade rather than becoming a permanent relic. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted, reciprocal paths, while self-recommendations add no credible weight. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity keeps its score below the consensus threshold, like basalt in a meadow: present, but not influential.
